name: Fujiwara no Michitsuna no Haha
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 53); Porter’s note gives the dates as: fl. 947–967.

poems.title: All through the long and dreary night
poems.author: Fujiwara no Michitsuna no Haha
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 53
poems.text:
All through the long and dreary night
I lie awake and moan;
How desolate my chamber feels,
How weary I have grown
Of being left alone!

poems.title: 53. 嘆きつつ 獨りぬる夜の 明くるまは (Nageki tsutsu hitori nuru yo no akuru ma wa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Michitsuna no Haha
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 拾遺集
poems.text:
嘆きつつ 獨りぬる夜の 明くるまは
いかに久しき ものとかは知る
